children: , an AI-enabled diversified holding company utilizing Transformational AI (TAI) to enhance portfolio performance announced today that it has entered into amendments to its existing lock-up agreements entered into in connection with the Company's direct listing with holders of the Company's outstanding shares of Class A Common Stock. The list of those signing the amendment includes the Company's founder and Chairman, other members of the Company's board of directors, members of management and a majority of its largest stockholders.

The revised release schedule incorporates a layered approach to share restrictions, with certain release dates being extended and the applicable percentages distributed over a longer period of time. The amended lock-up agreement extends restrictions on the sale of 70% of the shares restricted under the current lock-up agreements until mid-February 2027 when the restrictions fall to 50%. Restrictions then fall to 30% of the restricted shares in mid-March with the final 30% falling away entirely in mid-April 2027.

"We remain focused on protecting and enhancing long-term shareholder value," said Todd Furniss Chief Executive Officer and Co-Founder of AIAI Holdings Corporation. "The adoption of this revised restriction schedule reflects our commitment to disciplined capital management, responsible stewardship and a measured approach to managing our share structure. We believe this approach is in the best interests of the Company and our shareholders at this time."
